data.name: Five Nights At Monkeys VR
data.detailed_description:
The game is free on standalone platforms, but costs $4.99 here on Steam. This helps prevent ban evasion and abuse while keeping the price fair for everyone.

The Steam version also includes an exclusive bundle packed with cosmetics and shiny pebbles. This bundle is not included when the game is claimed during periods when it is temporarily made free on Steam, though it can still be purchased separately through other sources if you received the Steam version for free.

Five Nights At Monkeys is a VR horror experience where every night is completely different and full of surprises! Swing, grab, and climb with classic Gorilla Tag style arm movement as you survive roaming monsters, tricky power systems, and unexpected jump scares. From forest treehouses to canyon huts, city streets, and dark mines, each night brings new challenges and monsters.

After surviving the scares, step into the lobby… if you dare! Customize your look with cosmetics, test your skills in the parkour, or explore the museum for a glimpse of what’s next. Wander through the fanart area to see the community’s creations, and keep your eyes peeled cuz secrets hide everywhere, including the mysterious lab.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Valve Index, HTC Vive, and Meta Quest 2/3/Pro through SteamVR and Steam Link
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 3050
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Valve Index, HTC Vive, and Meta Quest 2/3/Pro through SteamVR and Steam Link
